Detailed Description

This class tests whether QDoc incorrectly reports "Multiple primary overloads" when different classes have methods with the same name, using shared comment nodes.

Member Function Documentation

void TestTime::toString() const

void TestTime::toString(int format) const

Returns the time as a string. The format parameter determines the format of the result string.

This uses shared comment nodes (multiple \fn commands) just like Eddy's qtbase change, which triggers the bug.

void TestTime::toString(const char *formatString) const

Returns the time as a string using the specified formatString.

This function overloads TestTime::toString().
